_comment: Sentry alert 1464194 (org myown-76, de.sentry.io), applied by the agent through the Sentry MCP. A new, regressed or returning game error emails the owner, at most once per 30 min per issue. Sentry's default 'high priority issues' alert is disabled on the save API project (1463992, it duplicated the save API emails) and kept on the game project (1463993) as a backstop. Production gets its own rule: sentry-game-alert-production.json.
name: Game error (new or returning): email owner
